name: write-through-projection
body:
The mutation updates the projection SYNCHRONOUSLY, as part of the mutation itself. There is no write-back buffer, no flush-at-end, and no session-end dependency: a mutation that reports success has already applied its exact node/edge delta to `apg/.trans/db.lbug`. This SUPERSEDES the write-back/batched buffer model (the former `solution.component.derived-projection-buffer`, now the write-through projection). Amortizing a DB open/parse across a session must never defer a mutation's visibility.

Acceptance: with or without a live session, the mutation's delta is present in `db.lbug` at the moment the mutation returns; killing the process immediately after success leaves the projection consistent with the durable sources.
